name: Cheri Berry
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to heal paralysis.

name: Chesto Berry
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to wake up.

name: Pecha Berry
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to cure poison.

name: Oran Berry
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to restore 10 HP.

name: Persim Berry
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to lift confusion.

name: Sitrus Berry
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to restore 25% HP.

name: Macho Brace
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It promotes strong growth but lowers Speed while it is held.

name: Everstone
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holding Pokémon is prevented from evolving.

name: Lucky Egg
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. An egg filled with happiness that earns extra Exp. points in battle.

name: Soft Sand
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A loose, silky sand that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

name: Normal Gem
description: A gem with an ordinary essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Normal-type move once.

name: Muscle Band
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a headband that slightly boosts the power of physical moves.

name: Wise Glasses
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick pair of glasses slightly boosts the power of special moves.

name: Air Balloon
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder floats in the air until hit. Once hit, this item will burst.

name: Safe Goggles
description: These goggles protect the holder from both weather-related damage and powder.

name: Punch Glove
description: A held item that boosts the power of punching moves and prevents direct contact with targets.
